nasa-tm-19700016380-flight-performance-o: Extra inlets and plug nozzles promise better jet performance. This 1970 NASA report measures the flight performance of an auxiliary inlet ejector and plug nozzle at transonic speeds. The flight tests showed whether the exotic nozzle earned its keep.
nasa-tm-19700025285-evasive-maneuver-sub: CSM/LM got evasive-maneuvered, and this 1970 NASA memo covers S-4B ejection. The pages detail the evasive findings. The engineers get their memo. The maneuver was subsequent-ejection. The memo was engineer. The ej were orbit. The Apollo were Project.
